Foundation.title: Commerce | A considered beginning
Foundation.heading: One account.
Foundation.description: A considered beginning. Your Commerce account is the first step toward what comes next.
Foundation.note: Your credentials stay between you and Commerce.
Foundation.artDescription: A space for what comes next.
Foundation.availability: Account access available. Marketplace coming next.

Accounts.registerDescription: A fresh start, with a place to call yours.
Accounts.signInDescription: Your next chapter is right where you left it.
Accounts.passwordHelp: Use 15–128 characters after Unicode normalization. Spaces count. Avoid common passwords, your email, or the service name.
Accounts.javascriptRequired: Enable JavaScript to use the account forms.
Accounts.acceptedHelp: If your account needs verification, check your email for a confirmation link. You can request another message below, then sign in after confirming.
Accounts.verificationDescription: Enter your registered Commerce password to finish confirming this email address.
Accounts.verificationRequestDescription: Enter your email address to request a Commerce confirmation link.
Accounts.verificationMissing: Open a valid confirmation link from your email to continue. If you need another link, request a message below.
Accounts.verificationPasswordHelp: Use your registered Commerce password. This step does not change it. Password recovery is not available yet.
Accounts.verificationSuccessHelp: Sign in with your registered credentials to continue.
Accounts.verificationAcceptedHelp: If your account needs verification, check your inbox for a confirmation link. If nothing arrives, wait a moment before requesting another.
Accounts.signedInHelp: You can sign out here when you’re finished.
Accounts.sessionRequired: Sign in to continue. Your session may have expired or is no longer available.
Accounts.checkUnavailable: We couldn’t check your session. Try again when the connection is available.
Accounts.signOutUnconfirmed: We couldn’t confirm sign-out. Your session may still be active on the server. Try signing out again.

errors.configuration: Account access is unavailable because the connection settings are invalid.
errors.unavailable: We couldn’t complete the request. Please try again. If you submitted it, it may already have been processed.
errors.timeout: The request took too long. It may already have been processed. Please try again when you’re ready.
errors.invalid: Check your email and password and try again.
errors.credentials: The email or password is incorrect. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: Account access is unavailable from this page. Please check the connection setup.
errors.limited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
errors.required: Enter a value for this field.
errors.email: Enter a supported email address, such as name@example.com.
errors.passwordEncoding: This password contains an unsupported Unicode sequence. Please enter it again.
errors.passwordSize: This password is too large. Use at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.
errors.passwordWeak: Choose a less common password that does not match your email or the service name.
errors.verificationRequired: Confirm your email before signing in. You can request another verification message below.
errors.verificationInvalid: We couldn’t confirm this link and password. The link may be expired or already used. Try your registered password, request another link, or try signing in if you already confirmed.

Accounts.studioDescription: One small step. A little more possibility. Make room for your next chapter with Commerce.
Accounts.accountPrivacy: Your account details stay private. Only your current session is managed here.
